title: Draught of Vananidir
content:
# Draught of Vananidir

Type: Mead | Internal ID: MeadSwimmer | Source: Fermenter | Usage: Drinking | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Mead base: Vananidir x1 | Duration: 5m | Cooldown: 0s | Other Effect(s): -50% swimming stamina consumption

# Introduction

Draught of Vananidir is a Swamp-tier consumable item fermented from Mead base: Vananidir.

## Recipe

Mead base: Vananidir is produced in a Mead ketill with:
• 10 Dandelion
• 2 Perch
• 1 Fresh seaweed
Six Draughts of Vananidir meads are produced by fermenting the mead base for two in-game days.

## Effect

Consuming it reduces stamina consumption when swimming by -50% for 5 minutes.

Categorias: Mead, Fermenter recipes, Items
